About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in London.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you'll own complex product and technical problems across the merchant experience, from problem definition through design, implementation, production, and ongoing evolution.

You'll:

  • Design, build, and operate production systems across backend services and user-facing applications.

  • Lead technically complex initiatives across areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.

  • Translate ambiguous business and merchant problems into scalable, pragmatic technical solutions.

  • Drive technical design and architecture decisions, considering scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long-term product needs.

  • Own systems and initiatives end-to-end, from early discovery and design through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and engineers across teams to align on solutions and delivery.

  • Support and mentor other engineers through design discussions, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining strong judgment around correctness, security, maintainability, and quality.

  • Work comfortably outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve problems end-to-end.

 

How We Work

  • Ownership: Senior engineers take responsibility not only for implementation, but also for understanding the problem, shaping the solution, and ensuring it works successfully in production.

  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations. Senior engineers are expected to help drive alignment when problems span multiple teams or areas.

  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.

  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with strong experience leveraging modern AI tools alongside solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.

  • Strong experience designing, building, and operating production software at scale in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments.

  • Experience owning complex features, services, or technical initiatives from problem definition through production and ongoing operation.

  • Strong understanding of system design, APIs, databases, distributed systems, testing, observability, and production reliability.

  • Experience making technical and architectural decisions where there are multiple valid approaches and meaningful trade-offs.

  • A track record of helping other engineers grow through mentoring, technical guidance, code reviews, or knowledge sharing.

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.

 

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.

  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.

  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.

  • Integrations with external business systems.

  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.

  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe.

The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

jobs.title: Resourcing & Associate Manager
jobs.description:
Resourcing & Associate Manager

Location: Our offices are in Central London

Defence/SC Clearance Requirements:

SC clearance is required for our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. DV clearance may be required for certain roles, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential.

About Cloudscaler

Cloudscaler is a rapidly growing cloud consultancy. We partner with ambitious enterprise and public sector customers to design, build, operate, and support secure, governed cloud platforms that meet the highest regulatory and industry standards.

We are scaling deliberately. Our revenue ambition depends on deploying the right people onto the right work quickly, and on making disciplined use of our capacity. This role is central to that.

The opportunity

This is a new role at the heart of how Cloudscaler resources delivery. You will own the day-to-day matching of our people to client work across our enterprise and growth accounts, and you will build and run a pool of trusted associates that gives us flexible capacity when we need it.

The role turns two of our core operating policies, the Bench Management Policy and the Utilisation & Time Recording Policy, into everyday practice. You will work alongside Engine Room leadership to keep bench colleagues productively deployed, and you will bring an AI-first mindset to a set of tasks that are currently manual. The ambition is a faster, fairer, more transparent resourcing process, run with less administrative overhead.

You will report to the Chief Consulting Officer and work closely with Engagement Managers, Delivery Managers, the Engine Room, the CRO function, and People operations. This is a build role. You will shape the process, not just follow it.

Responsibilities and outcomes

Resource matching and assignment

  • Own resource assignments across enterprise and growth client engagements, from incoming demand through to confirmed placement and mobilisation.

  • Match people to work against a rounded set of criteria: skills, experience, career progression goals, team preferences, client need, and personal asks such as location, industry, and preferred way of working.

  • Balance competing priorities fairly and transparently, holding the tension between billable utilisation and colleagues’ development and wellbeing.

  • Maintain an accurate, forward-looking view of who is available when, working from confirmed end dates and pipeline signals.

  • Flag capacity constraints and skills gaps to leadership early, with enough notice to act.

Bench management and utilisation

  • Support the application of the Bench Management Policy and the Utilisation & Time Recording Policy in day-to-day resourcing decisions.

  • Work alongside Engine Room leadership to suggest bench assignments, keeping colleagues on creditable internal work orders or Small Projects rather than idle bench time.

  • Feed the monthly bench report by keeping resourcing data clean and current across Timely and our HRIS, and support the move from a manual report to an automated one.

  • Help keep non-billable bench time within the agreed RAG thresholds, and give an early warning when capacity and pipeline are drifting apart.

  • Contribute to the weekly Engine Room checkpoint so available work and upcoming priorities are visible and mobilisation stays fast.

Associate pool sourcing and management

  • Build, curate, and grow a pool of trusted associates who can be called on for flexible or specialist capacity.

  • Proactively source associates ahead of need, based on recurring skills demand and pipeline, rather than scrambling when a gap appears.

  • Own the associate relationship: onboarding, quality assurance, engagement, and offboarding, so associates are ready to deploy and represent Cloudscaler well.

  • Maintain associate records, availability, rates, and compliance status, and match associates to demand on the same criteria used for permanent colleagues.

  • Work with commercial and People operations on the contractual, rate, and compliance framework for associates, including IR35 status where relevant.

AI and automation

  • Prioritise the use of AI and automation to cut manual effort across resourcing, matching, and reporting.

  • Identify the highest-friction manual tasks and design lighter, tool-supported ways of doing them, in step with the planned automation of the bench report.

  • Help specify and adopt resourcing tooling that gives a single, reliable view of demand, availability, skills, and the associate pool.

  • Champion accurate underlying data. Good matching and good AI both depend on it.

Reporting and stakeholder management

  • Give the Chief Consulting Officer regular, clear management information on availability, assignments, bench position, and associate coverage.

  • Act as the go-to point for Engagement and Delivery Managers seeking to resource an engagement, and set expectations honestly on what is achievable and when.

  • Coordinate with the CRO function so resourcing forecast and the sales pipeline stay aligned.

How success is measured

In the first 90 days you will have taken ownership of resource assignments across the enterprise and growth accounts, established a working associate pool, and mapped the manual tasks ripe for automation. Ongoing success looks like:

  • Faster time-to-assignment for enterprise and growth engagements, with fewer gaps between assignments for colleagues.

  • Onboarding support for new joiners to ensure a positive first experience of a project (whether internal or client facing)

  • Non-billable bench time held within agreed thresholds, with early flags when the position is moving.

  • A dependable associate pool that can be mobilised at short notice for flexible and specialist needs.

  • Measurable reduction in manual effort across matching and reporting, through AI and automation.

  • Trust from colleagues and managers alike that assignments are fair, transparent, and well matched.

Experience

Professional background

  • Proven experience in resource management, staffing, workforce planning, or delivery operations, ideally within a consultancy, professional services, or technology environment.

  • A track record of matching people to work against multiple, sometimes competing, criteria.

  • Experience building or managing an associate, contractor, or freelance network is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable holding the commercial tension between billable utilisation and investment in people.

Skills and approach

  • Genuinely AI-first. You reach for automation to remove manual work and can help specify and adopt the right tooling.

  • Highly organised, with strong attention to data accuracy and a calm approach to competing demands.

  • A clear, direct communicator who can set honest expectations and have straightforward conversations about capacity and priorities.

  • Confident working with data and MI, and with systems such as time recording and HR tools.

  • Collaborative and trusted, able to work across delivery, commercial, and People functions.

Desirable

  • Familiarity with cloud consultancy delivery and the roles involved, from Project and Engagement Managers through to Cloud Engineers, Consultants, and Architects.

  • Awareness of public sector delivery and security clearance requirements, and how these affect who can be placed on which work.

  • Exposure to IR35 and associated contractor compliance considerations.

  • Experience introducing or improving resourcing tooling and automation.

Why Cloudscaler

Cloudscaler is scaling rapidly and deliberately. Getting resourcing right is one of the biggest levers we have, and this role owns it. You will have genuine ownership of a new function, the freedom to design how it works, and the mandate to bring AI to bear on work that has always been manual. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Human AI Collaboration (all genders)
jobs.description:
We're looking for someone to own Human Understanding & Adaptive Collaboration as one of wingmaite's four foundational product disciplines. This isn't a traditional product role, you won't simply manage features or execute roadmaps. You'll define how wingmaite understands humans and collaborates with them, building the discipline through which experts externalize knowledge that only they currently hold.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Enterprise Knowledge Elicitation: Define how wingmaite interviews experts, asks follow-up questions, reconstructs decisions and surfaces tacit knowledge
  • Adaptive Collaboration: Decide when the system should ask, explain, interrupt, remind, wait, or deliberately not infer
  • Collaboration Conditions: Model the situation, not the person: authority, expertise, timing, necessary friction
  • Human Understanding Integrity: Establish what the product may legitimately learn about a person in context, and what it must deliberately leave unmodeled
  • Challenge the CPO, CTO and Engineers on questions inside your pillar as one of four intellectual owners at the company
  • Turn deep thinking into product behavior that's measurable and useful
  • Build toward a small team, starting as a strong individual contributor

What this role is explicitly not

HR tech. Employee analytics. Performance management. Personality profiling. Engagement optimization. Prompt engineering. Traditional UX research. wingmaite models conditions, not characteristics. No scoring people, no manipulating behavior, no inferring personality, no replacing human judgment.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • Background in AI product, human-computer interaction, cognitive science, knowledge engineering, learning sciences, human factors, behavioral design, or enterprise software
  • Exceptional product judgment and experimental thinking
  • Think in situations, decisions, authority, expertise, and conditions, not fixed user traits
  • Real ethical restraint: You know when a system should not infer something, even if it could
  • Ability to turn deep thinking into measurable product behavior
  • Fluent English (C1–C2)

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience building early-stage products or working in startup environments
  • Prior work with technical or expert users
  • Familiarity with enterprise software contexts
  • Hands-on mindset and technical skills that help you prepare prototypes and realize smaller features on your own

Who you are

  • You start with the decision someone's facing, their authority and expertise, not their personality traits
  • You can hold complex thinking and translate it into clear product decisions
  • You have real restraint about what systems should and shouldn't do
  • You take full responsibility for your discipline and its outcomes
  • You work closely with leadership, engineering, and customers to shape the product
  • You thrive on creating new disciplines, not executing existing ones

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Flexible remote setup
  • Learning & development opportunities
  • Generous vacation & workation budget
  • The opportunity to define one of four foundational product disciplines at wingmaite

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter explaining how you think about this question:

How must wingmaite understand a human and work with them so the collaboration is effective, appropriate, and legitimate?

Optional: include examples of product work!

jobs.title: Systemadministrator*in – IT Security & Endpoint Management
jobs.description:

Systemadministrator*in – IT Security & Endpoint Management

befristet auf 2 Jahre

Campact e.V ist eine Kampagnen-Organisation, mit der über 4,5 Millionen Menschen entschlossen für progressive Politik eintreten und unsere Demokratie verteidigen. Wenn wichtige politische Entscheidungen anstehen, starten wir Kampagnen – digital und auf der Straße. Wir schmieden breite Bündnisse und mobilisieren eine starke Bewegung für die gemeinsame Sache. Unsere Kampagnen treiben den ökosozialen Fortschritt voran und verteidigen unsere Demokratie. Damit eine gerechte Gesellschaft entsteht, in der alle Menschen sicher und selbstbestimmt in Frieden und Freiheit leben können.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir eine*n Systemadministrator*in – IT Security & Endpoint Management zur Verstärkung unseres aktuell dreiköpfigen Anwender*innen Support Teams.


Campact setzt als moderner Arbeitgeber auf Digitalisierung und Flexibilität – daher arbeiten unsere Mitarbeiter*innen fast ausschließlich im bezuschussten Homeoffice oder Co-Working-Space. Die Teamarbeit funktioniert über Mail, Chat, Video- und Telefonkonferenzen. Um unser gutes Teamgefühl zu fördern, ermöglichen wir regelmäßige persönliche Treffen und erwarten Reisebereitschaft für unsere Teamklausuren. Neben der Campact-Geschäftsstelle in Verden/Aller, die  teilweise als Anlaufpunkt dient, erwarten wir auch Reisebereitschaft, wenn Unterstützung vor Ort notwendig ist.

Deine Aufgaben

Mit Campact bewegen Menschen gemeinsam Politik. Mit Deiner Arbeit hältst Du dem Team den Rücken frei und unterstützt die Kolleg*innen bei technischen Herausforderungen. Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team unterstützt Du im Bereich Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit. Hierfür arbeitest Du eng mit den zuständigen Personen für Digital Security und Datenschutz zusammen. 

  • Du nimmst einen aktiven Part im Incident Response ein, unterstützt bei der Nachbetrachtung von Sicherheitsvorfällen und bei der Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Risikominimierung (z.B. Phising/Schadsoftware/0-Days).

  • Du unterstützt beim Risk Assessment und setzt Maßnahmen zur Risikoreduktion um und wirkst aktiv an der Erstellung und Pflege von Richtlinien, Prozessen und Dokumentationen im Bereich Informationssicherheit mit.

  • Du bewertest neue und bestehende Anwendungen auf IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance Anforderungen und unterstützt bei der Integration in unser Mobile-Device-Management-System und betreust diese gemeinsam mit Deinem Team. 

  • Du begleitest die Einführung neuer interne Dienste, kommunizierst mit internen wie externen Ansprechpartner*innen und betreust unsere bestehenden internen Systeme (wie IAM, Mail-Postfächer, Mailinglisten).

  • Du kümmerst Dich um die Beschaffung und Einrichtung von Hardware (Notebooks, Tablets, Mobilfunkgeräte) und Software.

  • Du unterstützt die User*innen bei alltäglichen Problemen mit Hard- und Software.

Unser Angebot

  • Du leistest einen direkten Beitrag zur positiven Veränderung von Politik und Gesellschaft, zu sozialer Gerechtigkeit, ökologischer Nachhaltigkeit, Toleranz und Gleichberechtigung.

  • Du erhältst eine Vergütung in Anlehnung an die TVöD-Entgeltgruppe 10 und 31 Urlaubstage.

  • Wir bieten Dir eine Vielzahl von attraktiven Sozialleistungen, u.a. monatliche Kinderzuschläge (bei Vollzeit z.B. 493,20 Euro für das 1. Kind).

  • Durch eine Homeoffice-Pauschale bezuschussen wir die Ausstattung für eine gesunde und produktive Remote-Arbeit.

  • In Hochphasen kommt es vor, dass Du auch mal an Wochenenden oder Abenden tätig oder rufbereit bist. Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Du Überstunden ausgleichen kannst und bezuschussen Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit. Die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ist uns bei Campact e.V wichtig. Zusammen mit dem Betriebsrat haben wir eine Verteilungslogik erstellt, die es uns ermöglicht,  individuelle Bedürfnisse zu berücksichtigen und gleichzeitig umgehend und flexibel auf politische Ereignisse reagieren zu können.   

  • Im Team arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, langfristig erfolgreich und selbstwirksam zu bleiben. Dabei spannt sich der Bogen von einer transparenten Kommunikation über eine wertschätzende und offene Feedback- und Führungskultur hin zum Feiern unserer gemeinsamen Erfolge.

  • Für Deine individuelle Gesundheit ermöglichen wir Dir Austauschmöglichkeiten mit Coaches und Psycholog*innen sowie eine vergünstigte Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft mit einer Vielzahl an Gesundheitsangeboten.

  • Wir sind ein innovativer Arbeitgeber mit rund 150 netten Kolleg*innen und einer tollen Arbeitsatmosphäre – ob remote oder auf den regelmäßigen Teamevents.

  • Wir setzen auf eine umfassende Einarbeitung, u.a. durch Pat*innen und ermöglichen Dir viele Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Campact e.V. ist eine NGO, die unabhängig von Politik und Wirtschaftsinteressen agiert, Transparenz wird bei uns großgeschrieben. (Hier geht es zum aktuellen Transparenzbericht).


Unsere Profilbeschreibung enthält eine Vielzahl sehr unterschiedlicher Kompetenzen, die wir für diese Stelle relevant finden. Bitte bewirb Dich, auch wenn nicht alle Punkte auf Dich zutreffen – alles Weitere können wir im gemeinsamen Gespräch klären.

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum*r Fachinformatiker*in für Systemintegration mit 3-5 Jahre relevanter Berufserfahrung im genannten Aufgabengebiet oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Du hast (erste) Erfahrungen in einem Security Operations Center (SOC) sammeln können und der Umgang mit SIEM sowie IAM - Systemen sind Dir vertraut.

  • Du erkennst automatisierungsfähige Prozesse und kannst diese mühelos als Python, Shell Skript oder Low-Code umsetzen.

  • Du kennst macOS in- und auswendig und bringst idealerweise auch Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Windows- und Linux-Umgebungen mit.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Mobil Device Management Systemen wie JAMF.

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen zusammen und hast eine lösungsorientierte und empathische Arbeitsweise.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Aufgaben, dabei sind Datenschutz und -sicherheit sind für Dich essentiell.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in NGOs oder engagierst Dich in der Politik und kannst aus dem Umfeld eine Referenzperson für Dein politisches oder gesellschaftliches Engagement nennen.

  • Du identifizierst Dich mit den Werten und der Arbeit von Campact.

Hast Du Lust auf diese Herausforderung? Dann lade Deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Foto, mit der Angabe Deines Pronomens, mit dem Du angesprochen werden möchtest, sowie der Angabe Deiner Referenzperson) in unser Bewerbungsmanagementsystem hoch.

Statt eines Anschreibens beantworte folgende zwei Fragen kurz (maximal auf einer halben Seite):

  • Warum bewirbst Du Dich auf diese Stelle?

  • Wie kannst du zur Sicherheit unserer Organisation beitragen?

Campact e.V. ist davon überzeugt, dass gesellschaftlicher Wandel nötig und möglich ist. Dabei müssen auch wir als Organisation uns weiterentwickeln – um uns noch besser für eine Welt engagieren zu können, in der alle Menschen ihre Freiheit gleichermaßen verwirklichen. Dazu braucht es auch Wandel in unserer personellen Aufstellung. Wir laden insbesondere Menschen mit Diskriminierungserfahrungen ein, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

Der Prozess ist mehrstufig, beinhaltet eine Probeaufgabe, ein Gespräch mit Fach- und Personalkolleg*innen und ein Kennenlerngespräch mit der Teamleitung und der Geschäftsführung. Der gesamte Prozess soll bis Ende Oktober abgeschlossen sein.

Weitere Informationen zu Campact e.V. findest Du auf www.campact.de.

jobs.title: Battery System Engineer/Architect (all genders)
jobs.description:
About Us

STARK is a European defence technology company building the next generation of unmanned systems. We design, develop and manufacture software-defined, mass-scalable and cost-effective platforms that give NATO operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance capability — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, our work strengthens the technological edge of NATO Allies and their partners.


Your mission

As a Battery System Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end design, development, and integration of high-performance battery packs for our fleet of drones. Because every gram and watt matters in aviation, you will focus heavily on optimizing for Size, Weight, and Power while ensuring uncompromising safety, thermal stability, and cycle life. You will work cross-functionally with mechanical, firmware, and aerospace engineers to seamlessly integrate the battery system into our application.


Responsibilities

  • System Design & Architecture: Lead the architectural design of bespoke battery packs tailored to the high-discharge and strict weight requirements of UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles).
  • BMS Integration: Work closely with firmware and electronics teams to define requirements for Battery Management Systems (BMS), including state-of-charge (SOC) and state-of-health (SOH) algorithms, cell balancing, and fault protection logic.
  • Thermal & Mechanical Management: Collaborate with mechanical engineers to design lightweight enclosures and thermal mitigation strategies that prevent overheating during peak flight loads.
  • Testing & Validation: Develop rigorous test plans for battery packs at the cell, module, and pack levels using testing equipment. Conduct thermal runaway, drop, vibration, and environmental testing.
  • Compliance & Safety: Ensure all battery designs meet relevant international safety and transport standards (e.g., UN 38.3).
  • Manufacturing Support: Partner with supply chain and external contract manufacturers to transition designs from prototype to mass production, ensuring high yield and quality control.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in battery system design, preferably in aerospace, automotive (EV), or consumer electronics

Technical Skills:
  • Deep understanding of lithium-based battery chemistries, failure modes, and degradation mechanisms.
  • Experience with BMS architecture, cell monitoring, and protection circuitry.
  • Proficiency in CAD software (e.g.,Catia) and PCB design/review tools (e.g., Altium).
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, I2C, and UART.

  • Hardware Experience: Hands-on experience building prototypes, soldering, and using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, electronic loads, battery cyclers).


Nice to have

  • Direct experience designing battery systems specifically for drones, eVTOLs, or other electric aircraft.
  • Familiarity with writing test scripts using Python or MATLAB for data analysis.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Finance Manager

Hybrid (UK-based) | Full-Time

Flexibility on how often you come into the office, as long as you're able to travel to the London office when required.

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Finance Manager to own the operational management of our finance function — accurate, timely management accounts, statutory accounts oversight, and the processes and controls that keep our finances reliable as we scale. You'll run month-end close, own balance sheet reconciliation and cash flow, lead the team responsible for AR/AP, payroll, VAT, and HMRC processes, and bring the analytical rigour that helps us make good financial decisions as we grow.

You'll also manage external relationships (auditors, solicitors, bankers), support external investment and funding activity, and run accounts across multiple business entities, including regulated entities in different geographies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Month-end close and reporting — own the close process end-to-end and prepare the monthly management accounts pack (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow), presenting to leadership as required

  • Balance sheet, cash flow, and VAT — reconciliations, cash flow forecasting, and end-to-end ownership of the quarterly group VAT return

  • Statutory accounts and audit — independently manage the year-end audit and contribute to annual statutory accounts under FRS 102

  • Team management — manage the AR & AP team, setting objectives and developing capability

  • Multi-entity accounting — accurate inter-company accounting across parent and subsidiary entities

  • Systems and process improvement — maintain and improve finance systems, identifying opportunities for efficiency gains

  • Strategic input — financial modelling and risk analysis to support decision-making, plus external investor/funding support

What We Need

Qualification:

  • ACA, ACCA, or CIMA qualified.

Experience:

  • Several years' experience in a small business finance function, with direct experience owning month-end and year-end close processes

  • Experience managing a junior team member or members

  • Experience running multiple business entities — parent and subsidiaries, including regulated entities across different geographies

  • Independent ownership of the year-end audit process

Systems:

  • Xero or similar is desirable but not essential where the candidate is system-adaptable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition — Video call, ~30-45 minutes

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally.

Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s future markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at startup-urgent pace.

jobs.title: Senior Brand Partnerships & Licensing Manager (All Genders)
jobs.description:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world's candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves, reformulated with less sugar and zero compromise on taste. We are 120 people strong, with 170+ SKUs and aggressive growth across D2C, retail, Amazon, and new European markets.

Our Brand Activation department is where we move from product to culture. We do that through limited editions: co-branded drops with entertainment IPs, licensing deals with cultural icons, collaborations that make people genuinely excited about what they are eating.

Are you a senior brand partnerships and licensing professional who closes deals, owns projects end-to-end, and has the network to make things happen from day one? If so, read on.


YOUR TASKS

  • Partner Identification & Pipeline Management: You proactively source, evaluate, and pitch licensing and co-branding opportunities across entertainment IPs, cultural icons, celebrities, and lifestyle brands. You run an active pipeline of 5-10 live opportunities at any given time and know which ones are worth pursuing for our brand and commercial goals.

  • Deal Negotiation & Contracting: You lead negotiations end-to-end and close with confidence. LOIs, licensing agreements, talent contracts, commercial terms, royalties, usage rights. You represent us in front of top-tier partners, agents, and IP holders and you get deals across the line.

  • End-to-End Project Management: You own the full lifecycle of every limited edition. Concept, LOI, product development, packaging redesign, legal sign-off, market launch. You keep cross-functional teams across brand, product, design, legal, sales, retail, and D2C moving in the same direction and on time.

  • Business Case & Performance Ownership: You build and own the business case for every collaboration: budget, margin, revenue forecast, and post-launch review. You track revenue contribution, retail sell-through, D2C performance, and brand awareness lift per edition, and use it to make the next one better.

  • Internal Alignment & Launch Enablement: You brief and align brand, social, ecom, and retail on launch strategy, content needs, and sell-in materials so every edition lands the way it should, in-store and online.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years in licensing, brand partnerships, or co-branding, ideally within FMCG, consumer lifestyle, entertainment, or a licensing/talent agency. You have taken 3+ limited editions or co-branded drops from concept to launch and can point to the results. You are a strategic thinker with a hands-on mindset and a proven execution track record.

  • You have negotiated and signed LOIs, licensing agreements, and talent contracts with full commercial responsibility. You come with a network of IP holders, agencies, talent managers, and entertainment companies that opens doors from day one.

  • You are comfortable juggling multiple complex workstreams at once, aligning cross-functional teams without formal authority, and holding a timeline without micromanaging. You have owned 6-7 figure budgets and built business cases from zero.

  • You communicate with confidence in both German and English. Native-level German and full fluency in English are required.

  • You take responsibility for your projects and your numbers, make clear decisions even when the path is not, and thrive where speed and ownership matter.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience working directly with entertainment studios, IP holders, or major talent agencies.
  • Background in FMCG, food & beverage, or better-for-you consumer brands.
  • Existing relationships in the DACH retail landscape with sell-in experience for limited editions.
  • Track record managing both D2C and retail launches at the same time.
  • Degree in Marketing, Media & Communications Management, Business Administration, or similar, though your track record matters far more than the diploma.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget

As a Data Engineer you will play a critical role in designing, building and maintaining our data infrastructure, ensuring efficient and accurate data processing, storage and retrieval.

jobs.title: Senior Mesh Network and MAC Engineer (All Genders)
jobs.description:
About Us

STARK is a defence technology company redefining the engineering and deployment of autonomous platforms. Our core mission is to deliver fully operational unmanned systems, integrating the critical subsystems, including Electronic Warfare, necessary for NATO forces to maintain a decisive advantage in contested environments. We do whatever is required to achieve platform autonomy, grounded in precision, responsibility, and uncompromising engineering discipline.


About the team

We are a lean, agile group with a strong systems-minded focus. We operate without silos, looking for proactive engineers who are excited to take mathematical models off the whiteboard and deploy them onto physical hardware. On our Electronic Warfare algorithms team, you will bridge the gap between theoretical signal processing and real-world hardware execution, taking direct ownership of key software and firmware modules.


Your mission

At STARK, we are building the next generation of autonomous platforms capable of navigating the world's most contested environments. As a Senior Mesh Network and MAC Engineer you will solve the critical challenges of directional wireless communication in highly dynamic networks. You will design and implement the medium access control (MAC) and routing layers that allow our platforms to form robust, self-healing networks under demanding tactical conditions.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement MAC protocols and routing algorithms tailored for directional multi-node systems, directly tackling the challenge of neighbour discovery under highly focused, narrow beams.
  • Build dynamic TDMA schedules and beam coordination mechanisms in lockstep with the physical layer (PHY) and antenna steering systems, ensuring routing decisions are grounded in real-time RF characteristics rather than simple hop counts.
  • Deliver resilient multi-hop relay capabilities that sustain high-bandwidth video and control links between mobile platforms over tactical distances, routing back seamlessly to ground control stations under dynamic conditions.
  • Build and maintain multi-node Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testbeds alongside automated logging pipelines to quantitatively evaluate and verify network join times and topology reform behaviours.
  • Mesh networking in a product that shipped — sim work alone does not qualify — plus Linux networking at kernel and packet level with live debugging.
  • Radio-literate and has designed a medium-access scheme or TDMA schedule.


Qualifications

  • You have successfully designed and shipped mesh networking protocols in commercial or defence products.
  • Deep, practical familiarity with the Linux networking stack at the kernel and packet levels, coupled with strong live-debugging skills on embedded systems.
  • Strong understanding of wireless propagation and physical layer realities, with hands-on experience designing medium-access control schemes or TDMA schedulers.


Nice to have

  • Active contributions to open-source routing protocols (e.g., batman-adv, olsrd, Babel).
  • A professional background at tactical mesh vendors (such as Silvus, Persistent Systems, TrellisWare, Saab, or Bittium).
  • Experience with mmWave backhaul systems or other technologies where directional beamforming is the default mode of operation.
  • Batman-adv / olsrd / Babel contributor; tactical mesh vendor background (Silvus, Persistent, TrellisWare, Saab, Bittium); mmWave backhaul — already thinks in beams.

Content and events. Two engines of Flock's marketing, and you own the execution of both.

Today the marketing team is one Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the brand and website, publishes the content, launches the products and runs up to nine events a year, getting it all out of the door by pushing AI hard. We're doubling the team and backing it with 3.5x the budget.

Events. You'll plan the calendar with the Senior Marketing Manager and own delivery: trade shows and conferences, plus our own broker and customer events. On each one you'll set the budget, build the stand, run the day, chase the leads and report on whether it was worth repeating.

Content. You'll shape the strategy with the Senior Marketing Manager, then produce it. Volume and quality both count. LinkedIn and the Flock blog are the priorities, plus video and website copy. AI. Flock runs on AI and we build AI products for customers too. Marketing is held to the same standard. Brokers and customers still respond to work that feels human, so you'll be someone who writes excellently and still has creative flair.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Make video. Film and produce videos with our team in and around the office: people stories, product walkthroughs and interviews.

  • Deliver events. Work with the Senior Marketing Manager Coordinate and execute our calendar of seven to nine events a year: trade shows, conferences and our own customer and broker events.

  • Design your own assets in Claude Design and Figma, to a standard that holds up next to agency work.

  • Work with AI daily. Draft, edit, repurpose and scale content with AI tools, applying your own voice and judgement so nothing reads machine-written.

 

What you'll need

  • Significant content creation and social media experience, ideally in B2B tech, with measurable results from owning and executing a social strategy.

  • A track record organising and coordinating trade shows, conferences or business events, plus internal events for customers and stakeholders.

  • Hands-on design skills in Figma and Claude Design. Adobe Creative Cloud would be a bonus.

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We’re looking for a full-stack Python engineer to join our Central Operations team.

Central Ops sits across our core products (Cards, Loans and Motor), focusing on shared operational challenges and opportunities. We build a mix of internally facing web applications and robust automations to help our Operations teams deliver great outcomes for customers, efficiently and at scale.

It’s a broad space: Operations makes up roughly half of our employee headcount and covers everything from day-to-day customer support up to complex areas like Fraud and Fincrime prevention. As our customer base grows rapidly, our role is to help ops keep pace without relying solely on headcount growth. We make intelligent, pragmatic use of AI where it adds real value, working closely with Product, Data Science and Analytics to deploy solutions that genuinely support our ops agents.

You’ll have real ownership from an engineering perspective, shipping features that are used daily by Ops teams. It’s an evolving space at Lendable, and what you build will help shape both our tools and our technical direction.

Some examples of things we’ve built recently:

  • Rebuilt our Ops QA admin system from the ground up, replacing an off-the-shelf tool with something tailored to our needs

  • Deployed a pipeline to summarise customer calls into concise notes using LLMs, automatically surfaced in ops admin panels — removing the need for manual note-writing

  • More than doubled the number of complaints processed by agents through a combination of targeted AI automation and improved UX

What we’re looking for

We’d consider the following essential to the role:

  • Solid experience with Python in a web application context. You have some experience with web frameworks like FastAPI, Django or Flask. We use FastAPI.

  • Experience with Javascript/Typescript and a modern JS framework such as React, Angular or Vue.js. We generally use React & NextJS

  • Strong engineering principles & practices: design patterns, testing, clean code and a good reviewer

  • Previous experience working in a product-focused team

  • A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team

  • A desire to learn about and experiment with Generative AI and LLMs. Actual experience is a plus

The following are also a plus, but by no means essential. If you don’t meet all of these, please apply anyway!

  • You use AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, Claude or others in your day-to-day coding

  • Exposure to Domain Driven Design, Message-Driven Systems and Event Sourcing

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS

  • SQL, and finding your way around data schemas

  • Shipping containerised software with Argo, Kubernetes, Docker and Terraform

  • Skill with CSS and exposure to Tailwind



Interview process

  • A 30 minute introductory call

  • Take Home Task

  • Technical Interview

  • Cultural/behavioural interview

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

Your role

As Senior Talent Acquisition Manager — GTM & Operations at bunch, you will own hiring across business roles. You will combine hands-on sourcing and closing with portfolio leadership, business judgment and trusted partnership with senior stakeholders.

You will:

jobs.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

 

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Developed Vetting (DV) and willing to work on site with our clients from time to time.

About the role

 

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build and scale AI-powered systems that solve unique challenges for global clients.

 

This is an opportunity to take ownership of the entire stack, turning sophisticated machine learning outputs into high-impact, production-ready solutions that drive real-world transformation.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Working in cross-functional teams, alongside Data Scientists and Product Managers, to deploy technically sophisticated, high-impact software.

  • Building reliable, and scalable frontend and backend architectures to enable the seamless delivery of advanced AI systems.

  • Building data pipelines and cloud infrastructure as part of wider AI systems.

  • Providing deep technical expertise to customers, helping them navigate complex requirements.

 

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You possess solid backend development skills in Python frameworks (such as FastAPI) and are comfortable managing the full application lifecycle.

  • You have full-stack experience and exposure to TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks like React or Vue

  • You have experience deploying software within cloud environments like AWS, Azure, or GCP, ideally using containerisation tools like Docker.

  • You demonstrate a scientific and pragmatic mindset, testing assumptions and balancing big-picture vision with the technical details required for execution.

  • You know how to maintain a balance between rapid prototyping and long-term maintainability.

  • You thrive in autonomous, fast-paced environments where you can take full ownership of problems.

  • You are a compelling communicator who enjoys working in a team-oriented culture and has a relentless drive to learn and apply novel technologies.

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

#LI-PRIO

 

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.
